ops.title: Headless browser QA on this box needs Chrome-for-Testing + raw CDP (rAF starvation blanks the docs site); docs tutorial URLs are un-numbered
ops.body:
QA-ing the captain-hook docs site (or any anti-FOUC site) in a headless browser on this machine: the default agent-browser executable is a `.clarkbrowser` anti-detect fork that cannot composite (screenshots hang), and headed Chrome won't launch. Worse, the site's `theme-init.js` removes `html.theme-loading` inside a requestAnimationFrame callback — a frame-starved headless tab never fires rAF, so the page stays blank. Working recipe (proved 2026-07-21): launch an isolated Google Chrome for Testing (`--headless=new` + swiftshader) on a private debug port with `--remote-allow-origins=*` and drive it over raw CDP — an active CDP connection produces frames, so rAF fires and `beginFrame` screenshots work. `caffeinate -u` first (see [[agent-browser-display-sleep]]).

Also: deployed tutorial page URLs drop the numeric prefix — `docs/tutorial/first-block.html`, `stop-gates.html`, `test-then-ship.html`, `walk-the-command.html` — while the qmd sources are `01-first-block.qmd` etc. Numbered `.html` guesses 404.
